assumptions: Exactly two processes each make at most one passage.
Sequential consistency with individually atomic shared reads and writes and preserved process order.
Both processes use the same fixed short-circuit read order; either modeled order and either initial tie-break value are covered.
The checked principal theorem uses only the standard Lean assumptions propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
non_goals: Safety alone provides no progress guarantee.
No waiting bound, repeated-client behavior, weak-memory correctness, executable-code refinement or n-process theorem.
summary: In the two-process model, no state reachable after any finite execution has both processes in their critical sections. This holds for either initial tie-break value and either fixed short-circuit wait order shared by both processes.
